v.t: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

v.t: Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth.

v.t: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.

v.t: When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall ye also appear with him in glory.

v.t: For which things’ sake the wrath of God cometh on the children of disobedience:

v.t: In the which ye also walked some time, when ye lived in them.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Col 1:1).

v.t: Lie not one to another, seeing that ye have put off the old man with his deeds;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Col 1:1).

v.t: And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Col 1:1).

v.t: Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Scythian, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Col 1:1).

v.t: Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Col 1:1).

v.t: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Col 1:1).

v.t: And above all these things put on charity, which is the bond of perfectness.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Col 1:1).

v.t: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also ye are called in one body; and be ye thankful.

v.t: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Col 1:1).

v.t: And whatsoever ye do in word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him.

v.t: Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord.

v.t: Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Col 1:1).

v.t: Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Col 1:1).

v.t: Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Col 1:1).

v.t: Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eyeservice, as menpleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God:
